If you've **already purchased the lock**, typical installation pricing around Melbourne is often in the **A$150–A$300** range for a straightforward replacement, although more complex doors (mortise locks, drilling, or wiring) can cost more. [www.airtasker.com](https://www.airtasker.com/au/services/lock-installation/maribyrnong-vic/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Before booking, it's worth confirming:
- The **brand and model** of your smart lock (e.g. Aqara, Yale, Lockly, Philips, Samsung).
- Whether your door uses a **deadbolt** or **mortise lock**.
- Whether any **door drilling or modifications** are required.
